selection_rule: Use real existing artifacts. Selection does not create conformance, promotion, certification, canonical status, publication authority, or downstream-use authority. A class remains deficient until a qualifying artifact completes the applicable G0-G9 pilot review.

classes.selection_basis: Actual certified and published mathematical result package with explicit theorem identity, proof/replay route, prior-art boundary, negative claims, and publication status.
integrity_constraints: Apply MATH_CORE_INTEGRITY.md before adding any mathematical communication mapping.
Do not treat the GCL-TCS pilot as mathematical recertification or canonical Claim Ledger promotion.
Do not invent MATH-CORE migration merely to complete the pilot.

classes.selection_basis: A benchmark harness, plan, notebook, or generated possibility is insufficient. The row stays deficient until a completed real experiment, simulation, benchmark, computational proof, data analysis, or visual-result package is verified with immutable evidence.
integrity_constraints: Do not manufacture an experiment or publication merely to satisfy criterion 8.
Record negative search evidence and burden in successor measurement work.

classes.selection_basis: Real protected software component with deterministic API, hostile/edge-case tests, fail-closed semantics, and an explicit no-mutation authority boundary.
integrity_constraints: Pilot review may assess communication, software contract, provenance, limitations, and authorized uses only.
It may not grant repository-admission, workflow, routing, ruleset, protection, controller, mathematical, certification, or publication authority.

classes.selection_basis: Existing admitted GHOS documentary pilot completed G0-G9 and directly covers operational procedure/runbook communication as a secondary P01 profile.
integrity_constraints: Reuse the historical completed pilot as evidence; do not reopen terminal GHOS source objects.
Later estate changes require successor admission or revalidation rather than rewriting this record.

classes.selection_basis: Binding governance instrument with explicit authority, scope, evidence-closure, concurrency, CI proportionality, recovery, and reserved-boundary semantics.
integrity_constraints: GCL-TCS review may expose governance meaning and limitations but cannot amend the governing directive.
Any source change remains a separate protected authority transaction.

classes.selection_basis: Already-published public technical artifact with explicit mathematical status, public claim, novelty/priority exclusions, certified declarations, and publication-gate evidence.
integrity_constraints: Review the existing publication; do not republish or widen its public claims merely to satisfy the pilot.
Public presentation cannot promote mathematical status beyond the certified and audited source claim set.
